newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices in modest gains.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices in modest gains.

text.p: Indian cotton prices saw modest gains on Wednesday on low mill buying ahead Friday's government budget, dealers said.

Rising expectation that government may allow more exports sent up prices. In spot deals Bengal-deshi rose by five rupees at 780/825 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned rose by 15 rupees at 1,425/1,625 rupees per maund.
Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) recovered by 100 rupees to 11,200/11,400 rupees per candy 355.56 kg. It was down by 300 rupees per candy on Tuesday.
Overall market sentiment was quiet at the close and volumes were at a low ebb as millers remained cautious buyers before the budget.
